scope_note: HIGH = a child that can outlive the call, a shell hop, or a scheduled-task action that owns a console for its whole life. MEDIUM = a bounded subprocess call that still needs the helper when its caller has no console; reported, not hidden, and not counted as fixed.

origin.interpretation: a GUI ancestor has no console, so the first console-subsystem child is given a new one: that allocation is the window. A console ancestor passes its console down, so no new window is created for its descendants.
